name: facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.warp_flow: warp an image using an optical flow field with optional normalized coordinates
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.cat_imgflo: concatenate an image with its optical flow visualization as colored arrows
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.point_vec: draw arrow vectors on an image to visualize optical flow direction and magnitude
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.flow_to_image: convert an optical flow map into a Middlebury color-coded image for visualization
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.compute_color: compute a color-coded optical flow image from horizontal and vertical flow components

facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.readPFM: read a PFM file and return the numpy array data and scale factor
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.write_pfm: write a numpy array as a PFM file to the given path with optional scale
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.readPFM_color: read a color PFM file with PF header and return height width 3 data
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.readPFM_grayscale: read a grayscale PFM file with Pf header and return height width data
facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/ext_u.write_pfm_flow: write a 2 channel flow field as a PFM file by padding to 3 channels
